note: Gin Toolbar Custom Menu replaces the Gin admin toolbar's 'admin' menu with a chosen menu on a per-role basis. All state is in the config object gin_toolbar_custom_menu.settings (FullyValidatable): keep_admin_menu (int) and a 'settings' sequence of rules {menu, role[], excluded_role[], icons[], admin_menu, actions[]}. Configure route /admin/config/system/gin-toolbar-custom-menu (permission 'configure gin toolbar custom menu'); assigned roles also need core 'access toolbar'. There is no config/install default so the object is absent until saved. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection reads a configured rule's menu and keep_admin_menu; execution creates a rule and enables keep_admin_menu, verified against the live config object.

evals.prompt: What does the gin_toolbar_custom_menu module do, and at which admin path do you configure it?
evals.expected_output: It lets you replace the Gin admin toolbar's menu with a chosen menu per user role; configure it at /admin/config/system/gin-toolbar-custom-menu.

evals.prompt: Which permission controls access to the Gin Toolbar Custom Menu settings form, and what extra core permission must a targeted role have for the custom toolbar menu to actually appear?
evals.expected_output: The module permission 'configure gin toolbar custom menu' gates the settings form; assigned roles must also have the core 'access toolbar' ('Use toolbar') permission or the toolbar/menu won't show.

evals.prompt: In gin_toolbar_custom_menu, each configured rule maps something to something. What are the key parts of a rule (which menu, which roles), and what config object stores them?
evals.expected_output: Each rule in gin_toolbar_custom_menu.settings 'settings' has a menu (machine name), a list of assigned roles, optional excluded_role, per-item icons and an admin_menu visibility option; a matching role gets the toolbar admin menu replaced by that menu.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Gin Toolbar Custom Menu is configured with a rule for the authenticated role. Which menu will replace the toolbar's admin menu for that role? Inspect the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: The 'main' menu - gin_toolbar_custom_menu.settings settings[0].menu is 'main' with role including 'authenticated'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, does Gin Toolbar Custom Menu keep the original administration menu alongside the custom menu? Inspect the live configuration and state the keep_admin_menu value.
evals.expected_output: Yes - gin_toolbar_custom_menu.settings keep_admin_menu is 1 (the original administration menu is kept).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Gin Toolbar Custom Menu so that users with the 'authenticated' role see the 'main' menu in the Gin admin toolbar instead of the default admin menu. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: gin_toolbar_custom_menu.settings 'settings' contains a rule with menu 'main' and role including 'authenticated' (e.g. configFactory getEditable('gin_toolbar_custom_menu.settings')->set('settings', [['menu'=>'main','role'=>['authenticated'], ...]])->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Gin Toolbar Custom Menu currently hides the original administration menu. Change its configuration so the original administration menu is also kept alongside the custom menu. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: gin_toolbar_custom_menu.settings keep_admin_menu is set to 1 (e.g. configFactory getEditable(...)->set('keep_admin_menu', 1)->save()).
